name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.5-r3: mounted fire visuals (cone, flame mesh, particles, #fire-glow, 🔥) stay at full strength from isFireActive()/burstLeft until the last ~200 ms fade. The snout particle stream is one reused Points draw (no extra burst per refill) so PROXY Low fire stays ≤70. The once-per-second fire tick logs each element's visible state, opacity and scale plus #fire-glow computed opacity and animation. The keep-playing overlay no longer appears on purposeful unlocks (B, I, Esc, or any open menu/panel); the next canvas click relocks. Pickaxe assist also counts rocks within ~3 m in the front half of view. ?debug=keys&rock=front or debug Key K faces/spawns a nearby rock (inert without ?debug). House building stays piece-based (Floor/Wall/Roof/Door/Window), not a single house kit. Schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
